optimized_sql:
WITH relevant_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_data AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_last_name,
        c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
store_sales_mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date
    FROM store_sales AS s
    JOIN relevant_dates AS d
        ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data AS c
        ON s.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_sales_mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales AS s
    JOIN relevant_dates AS d
        ON s.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data AS c
        ON s.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
),
web_sales_mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date
    FROM web_sales AS s
    JOIN relevant_dates AS d
        ON s.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data AS c
        ON s.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_sales_mv AS ss
JOIN catalog_sales_mv AS cs
    ON ss.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cs.c_last_name
   AND ss.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cs.c_first_name
   AND ss.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cs.d_date
JOIN web_sales_mv AS ws
    ON ss.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ws.c_last_name
   AND ss.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ws.c_first_name
   AND ss.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ws.d_date
LIMIT 100
